task: Literal lookup of an unambiguous text or data value, copying, counting or fixed replacement
selection_note: Direct reads and exact replacements have mechanical acceptance and can use Luna.

task: Structural mapping under complete fields and rules
selection_note: Complete mapping rules make the result independently checkable. All profiles share Luna/High for multi-field mapping.

task: Specified execution with behavior, mechanism and steps fixed
selection_note: When behavior and procedure are fixed, reserve stronger pairs for tasks that require choosing the procedure.

task: Bounded source discovery: search a predefined scope using mechanical selection criteria
selection_note: A predefined search and mechanical selection use the specified-execution pair. The source list still needs to be found.

task: Bounded reading of labels, positions or relations directly from an image
selection_note: MMMU-Pro tests broader multimodal reasoning. It supports comparing the small Medium-to-High gain for bounded visual work.

task: Document QA: locate and combine stated facts in supplied material
selection_note: GDP.pdf favors Sol/Medium over High in the captured point estimates. Quality and Extra Quality retain High provisionally for broader document QA.

task: Local investigation: trace bounded code behavior or diagnose a local issue, including by comparing logs
selection_note: Keep bounded diagnosis on Terra and reserve a separate route for interacting paths or disputed evidence.

task: Fidelity review against an accepted source or reference
selection_note: An accepted source or reference supplies the check. Evidence judgment covers checking whether the source claim itself holds.

task: Open-ended evidence research: discover sources, verify their authority and judge coverage under a defined question
selection_note: Epoch real-work cases help define coverage checks. There is no matched effort and cost comparison for ordinary open research.

task: Substantive evidence judgment within a given framework
selection_note: Applying an agreed framework requires evidence judgment. The additional quality premium is a policy choice.

task: Interpret established rules across sources when applicability, priority or exceptions require judgment
selection_note: Harvey tests rule application in legal deliverables. Scope, exceptions and false findings matter.

task: Quantitative analysis under a defined metric, with material differences in sources or measurements to reconcile
selection_note: AnalystAgent tests finance question answering. Costs for the five-attempt all-correct measure are unknown.

task: Interpret visual evidence under a given framework when the image determines the conclusion
selection_note: Visual evidence interpretation depends on the reasoning needed to reach a conclusion. Separate it from direct image extraction.

task: Heavy evidence synthesis or coupled behavior review: reconstruct disputed chronology, causal chains or interacting execution paths under established criteria
selection_note: MLCR measures evidence synthesis. Its accuracy component can rank pairs differently, and it does not measure code review.

task: Closed hard QA: fixed answer acceptance requires independent problem solving or external domain knowledge
selection_note: HLE-Diamond measures hard fixed-answer questions. Extra Quality pays for the additional benchmark accuracy.

task: Natural writing with content and claims settled
selection_note: OpenAI guidance supports Terra for natural prose. Validate against the supplied claims and the requested voice.

task: Ordinary code implementation: clear behavior; choose local implementation and tests
selection_note: FrontierCode scores repository changes without a local-only stratum. The ordinary-code defaults reserve bigger premiums for integration.

task: Demanding code integration: implement established mechanisms while tracking integration constraints
selection_note: Compare the extra credit and cost on FrontierCode. PatchBench and the OpenAI FrontierCode run provide separate checks.

task: Stateful tools: perform established operations where tracking state or applying workflow constraints is central
selection_note: Read strict passes with the separate violation rate. Quality accepts a premium for fewer AA violations with a small strict-pass tradeoff.

task: End-to-end tools: environment exploration, implementation, execution and feedback determine a working deliverable
selection_note: LifeVal gives a check on exploration and feedback. BenchCAD and Agents’ Last Exam cover different tasks and harnesses.

task: Recovery of an unfamiliar terminal environment with a repeatable check
selection_note: Terminal-Bench covers several kinds of terminal work. The repeatable recovery check narrows the use of this proxy.

task: Scientific execution: numerical implementation, computation and validity are the main burden
selection_note: AA favors Astra/Xhigh on both score and cost. OpenAI favors Max for a premium in its separate run.

task: Construct or reassess premises, system contract or evaluation framework
selection_note: Developing an acceptance contract is open judgment. The coding and tool benchmarks apply after the contract is set.

task: Jointly construct assumptions, methods and observables
selection_note: The higher tiers pay for joint design of the method and observables. Matching effort comparisons are unavailable.

task: Sustained difficult proof, deep derivation or counterexample search
selection_note: Sustained formal reasoning calls for its own route. A score on fixed-answer QA cannot establish proof quality.

task: Original visual communication beyond interfaces, where the information hierarchy or diagram must be designed
selection_note: Original hierarchy or diagrams require design decisions. Broader presentation rubrics do not isolate this work.

task: Original 2D interface design with key layout or interaction decisions
selection_note: OpenAI design guidance informs the default. Compare actual rendered layout and interaction for the brief.

task: Complex interactive browser 3D with substantial scene design or 3D interaction work
selection_note: AA-3D compares interactive Three.js scenes. Its domain scores lack matching domain costs and lower-effort results.
